column1: # analysis/naming2/wramx_consumers.tsv -- consumer rules of tools/apply_ram_operands.py --areas wramx (docs/research/naming2_ramop7.md)
# A raw pointer operand `ld hl|de|bc, $Dxxx` is banked WRAM: the same address is another variable in every bank.  It is written as the name of ram/banked.asm for the bank of the rule when

# the routine that receives the register (the first call/farcall/tail jp of the straight line, only plain instructions touching neither the register nor the bank in between) dereferences it in that bank.
# needs: `-` the routine selects the bank itself; `switch` the caller does, and the tool must find the bank idiom (`ld a, $0N / ldh [hWRAMBank], a / ldh [rSVBK], a`, or a call that sets the bank:
# analysis/naming2/wramx_calls.tsv) of that bank earlier in the same straight line.  family: a regular expression the chosen name must match (a rule is about one kind of object).
# The name states the bank in which the consumer dereferences the pointer; the caller's own bank may be another one.

column6: 00:0A82 saves the bank shadow and selects bank 7 itself (`ld a, $07 / ldh [hWRAMBank], a / ldh [rSVBK], a`, 00:0A92-0A96) before FillBytes zeroes the 16 bytes at HL and Sprite_LoadObjectEntry fills the slot, then restores the saved bank (00:0AB0-0AB3); observed bank 7 only at 00:0A98-0AB3 in 41 scenarios
00:0A65 saves the bank shadow and selects bank 7 itself (00:0A6D-0A71), stores D at [HL] and E at [HL+1], then restores the saved bank; observed bank 7 only at the stores in 41 scenarios
00:09E6 saves the bank shadow and selects bank 7 itself (00:09EF-09F3), FillBytes sets the 16 bytes at HL to $FF, then restores the saved bank; observed bank 7 only in 31 scenarios

00:0A45 saves the bank shadow and selects bank 7 itself (00:0A4E-0A52), stores E, D, A at [HL], [HL+1], [HL+2] (the hook of the slot, slot + $0B), then restores the saved bank; observed bank 7 only in 18 scenarios
4F:4000 selects bank 7 itself (4F:4002-4006) and leaves it selected, then the inline far call to 00:050C copies BC bytes (8 to 64) from HL to DE; the 173 destinations seen all lie inside $D800-$D87F
4F:404B uploads 8 BG palettes from [HL] and 8 OBJ palettes from [HL + $40] and does not select a bank; its callers select bank 7 first (observed: bank 7 only at 4F:404B-4082 in 41 scenarios)
4F:400E copies the hardware palettes (BCPD/OCPD) into [HL] and [HL + $40] and does not select a bank; its callers select bank 7 first (observed: bank 7 only in 21 scenarios)

69:4034 takes a sprite slot in HL (reads its +$0F byte with `ld bc, $000F / add hl, bc`) and does not select a bank: ConnIcon_Refresh (69:401A) selects bank 7 right before calling it (engine/comm/connection_icon.asm:32-38), and Sprite_StepAndDrawSlot runs it as the per-frame hook of slot 8 (installed by ConnIcon_StartSprite, engine/browser/status_sprites.asm:107-110) with bank 7 selected by Sprite_UpdateAll; observed bank 7 only at 69:4034-4042 in 6 scenarios
00:050C copies BC bytes from [HL] to [DE] in the bank in force and writes no bank register; the palette staging buffer is bank 7, so the rule holds where the bank-7 idiom stands in the same routine
